feedback: Great hook with the flash-forward cold open. The tension escalates well towards the end with the phone and mirror twist. Ensure the narration maintains the warm, intimate tone specified in the storyteller style guidelines.
lines: Mirror mein maine apni hi maut ka aakhri pal dekha!
Par ye sab shuru hua jab maa so rahi thi.
Udaipur ke heritage hotel mein raat ke teen baj rahe the.
Karan akela bathroom mein 3 AM vlog record kar raha tha.
Us purane brass mirror par achanak dhundh chhane lagi.
Karan ki saansein ruk gayi jab reflection ne palat kar nahi dekha.
Uske haath kaanp rahe the, phone ki battery low thi.
Mirror toot gaya aur wahan koi nahi tha.
Lekin phone ki screen chalu thi.
Recording mein woh khud nahi, uska mara hua future self tha.
Aaj raat apna phone utha kar mirror mat dekhna, shayad koi aur record kar raha ho.
